goal: Harden COS Graph Engine deterministic identity so canonical serialization accepts only plain JSON-like values, rejects ambiguous/executable object forms, and normalizes Unicode to NFC without expanding into provider case rules or registry immutability.
acceptance: stableSerialize rejects undefined, bigint, unsupported object prototypes, accessors, symbol properties, sparse arrays, and arrays with extra enumerable properties.
String values, object keys, authority, resource type, and resource IDs normalize to Unicode NFC before canonicalization.
Distinct object keys that collapse to the same NFC key are rejected.
A dedicated regression suite proves every listed boundary.
Planner, Builder, Test Engineer, Security Reviewer, and Code Reviewer are separated roles.
No agent receives Git write or merge authority.
